component.name: ThinkPad BIOS Settings
component.summary: Change ThinkPad firmware settings without rebooting into BIOS setup

description.p: A desktop editor for the firmware settings your Lenovo ThinkPad exposes to Linux through the think_lmi kernel driver. Everything is read and written through fwupd, so the application itself runs unprivileged and asks for authentication the same way any other system tool does.

ul.li: Every firmware attribute grouped into readable categories, each with a plain-English explanation of what it does on Linux
Changes are staged and written in a single batch, so you authenticate once no matter how many settings you edit
Clear warnings before anything that can lock you out of your own machine, such as disabling the TPM or a setting whose "permanently disable" value cannot be undone
Tells you when changes are staged but not yet active, and offers to restart

description.p: Requires a Lenovo ThinkPad whose firmware exposes settings through the think_lmi driver. Most settings take effect only after a restart.
